description: Erection of a single storey side extension and a single storey rear extension following the demolition of existing single storey rear conservatory; installation of 2no. rooflights in the front roofslope, re-sizing and replacement of 1no. existing rooflight and installation 1no. new rooflight in the rear roofslope; erection of balustrade around the flat roof and replacement of an existing door to the rear elevation at second floor level.
